Commentary.Commentary: A reality check for Papua New Guinea. It has been their top order which has been performing but it failed today. Their lower order stepped up though. Can their bowlers now fire? Time to find out...

Emmanuel Bundi says that he only looked to land it in line of the stumps. Admits that he was surprised to see the ball move so much, given that this was the same pitch which was used yesterday. In the team meeting, Bundi says that they need to restrict PNG to at least under 100. Thanks his teammates for supporting him. On the run chase, Emmanuel says that they will look to chase this down in 10 overs. Then smiles.

The Kenyan side will be delighted. Probably they will have some regrets, given that PNG were 19/6 at one stage. Emmanuel Bundi broke the back of the opposition, with three wickets in the opening over and at that stage, it looked like even 50 would be difficult. But the 77-run stand between Vanua and Bau gave the total some respectability. Here is the wrecker-in-chief, talking to Dirk Nannes.

OUT! BOWLED! The innings finally ends, in the final over. Full and straight, Kila looks to play a wild slog, but misses it comprehensively. The leg stump is uprooted. PAPUA NEW GUINEA BOWLED OUT FOR 118!
There is no one to return the ball. One of the Kenyan fielders himself goes into the stands to retrieve it.
SIX! WALLOP! Full and around middle, Kila gets down and mows a slog sweep over wide long on!
Landed outside off, punched towards long off for a single.
Floated delivery on leg, Kila looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up delivery on off, Pokana lofts it over mid off. The batsmen get a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, Pokana looks to cut but misses it.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Pokana looks to go after it but misses it.
Tossed up delivery on off, Pokana lofts it over mid off but it lands safely in no man's land. The batsmen get two runs.
Short delivery on middle, Pokana pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
DROPPED! Short delivery outside off, Pokana looks to pull but gets a bottom edge on this one. It goes towards the keeper who tries to take it but fails to hold on.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
SIX! That is high full toss and Kila dispatches it over square leg for half a dozen!
Full and around off, Pokana looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Nosaina Pokana is the last man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is a sensational piece of fielding. Full and around middle, Kila looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls to the leg side. The batsmen go for the single but Irfan Karim, the keeper, races to his right, towards square leg, picks it up and with one hand, off balance, throws it at the striker's end. Direct hit and Ravu is gone!
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Shem Ngoche returns. 2-0-11-0 so far.
Tossed up delivery on off, Ravu plays it to point. 6 runs and 2 wickets from the over.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Ravu looks to go after it but misses it.
Damien Ravu comes in to bat at number 10, replacing Vanua.

OUT! CAUGHT! The highest scorer of the innings departs now. Flighted delivery on middle, Vanua comes down the track and lofts it over mid on but does not get the timing on it. It goes towards Lucas Oluoch who takes a good catch. Fine knock from Vanua. Has given his team something to bowl at.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Vanua looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Jason Kila comes in at number 9, replacing Bau.

OUT! CAUGHT! Short delivery on middle, Bau pulls it over mid-wicket but does not get the distance on it. It goes towards Jasraj Kundi who takes a comfortable catch. The partnership is broken at last, on 77.
Tossed up delivery on off, Bau plays it to point.
FIVE WIDES! Bowls it down the leg side, Bau looks to go after it but misses it. It goes past the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.

In other games across the world, Australia have thrashed Sri Lanka by 134 runs, after David Warner scored his maiden T20I ton on his 33rd birthday. In Abu Dhabi, Nigeria have been restricted to 81/8 after electing to bat, by Hong Kong.
Flighted delivery on off, Bau looks to go big but misses it. The keeper whips the bails off and takes it upstairs. Replays show that Bau was inside the crease.
Length delivery on off, Bau plays it towards point. The batsmen take a single. 10 runs have come from the over. 21 runs have come from the last 2 overs.
On a good length and outside off, Bau looks to cut but misses it.
Outside off, Norman looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point. A single taken.

FOUR! MAIDEN T20I FIFTY FOR VANUA! What a knock it has been. Came in when his side was in doldrums and has taken them to a respectable total. Who knows, could get match-winning as well, if he stays till the end. Short and outside off, Vanua rocks back and cuts it through point. The ball races away!
Landed outside off, punched towards cover.
FOUR! Short and around off, Vanua pulls it through square leg for a boundary!
Sachin Bhudia comes on again. 2-0-14-0 so far.
Flighted delivery on off, Vanua plays it towards point. The batsmen cross ends. 11 runs have come from the over.
Tossed up on off, Bau punches it towards point for a run.
Short delivery on off, Vanua cuts it towards point for a single.
BEATEN! Tossed up outside off, Vanua looks to cut but misses it.
SIX! VIOLENCE! Full and around off, Vanua comes forward and slogs this over long on!
Tossed up delivery on middle, Vanua lofts it over mid on. The fielder at long on runs and does well to stop it before the ropes. The batsmen get two runs.
Pushpak Kerai comes on.
Length delivery on off, Vanua plays it towards covers. The batsmen cross ends.

On a length on middle, Vanua flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs. 50-PARTNERSHIP IS UP. In 61 balls. This is exactly what PNG required - both in context of the game and the tournament. Their top order has been firing so far and today, when it failed, the lower order has stepped up.
The mandatory concussion test is being done. The batsman says he is fine but the umpire still calls for the physio. No risks being taken these days.
Short of a length delivery, Vanua looks to pull but gets hit on the helmet. The ball deflects towards point.
Length delivery on middle, Vanua flicks it to mid-wicket.

On a length on leg, Vanua looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the keeper where he dives to stop it but it goes through him towards fine leg. The batsmen pick up a couple. No signal from the umpire, so must have been an inside edge.
Short delivery on middle, Vanua pulls it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Emmanuel Bundi returns. 3-0-11-4 so far. Can he get a 5-fer and break this partnership?
Short delivery on off, Bau cuts it to point.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Bau flicks it to mid-wicket.
Floated delivery on middle, Bau flicks it to the leg side.
Short delivery outside off, Vanua slaps it through covers for a single.
SIX! First of the match. Amazing shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Vanua lofts it over long on for a maximum. The ball is lost, right onto the top tier and a box of balls comes out.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
The skipper is back. Shem Ngoche has figures of 1-0-4-0 so far.
Full and down the leg side, flicked uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
A length ball outside off, Norman looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which is collected by the keeper on the bounce.
A bit of a delay. After that collision, Bau is receiving some medical treatment.

Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple. A collision there, as Bau, while coming for the second, collides with the fielder coming in to take the throw from the deep. Bau crosses the crease while the fielder is felled. Vanua moves to 20 from 27 balls.
Full and around middle, pushed with soft hands towards cover for a run.
Landed outside off, punched through the covers for a single. 50 UP FOR PNG.
Jasraj Kundi to bowl as well. Right-arm medium. The keeper is up.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a couple.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. A strong appeal from the bowler and fielders. The umpire shows no interest in the appeal.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Outside off, punched through the off side for a single.
Collins Obuya to bowl now. Leg breaks.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot towards long on. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Probably the first bad ball of the day. A full toss, down the leg side, Vanua flicks it over square leg and gets a boundary! Just the third of the inning. Vanua moves to 13 from 19 balls.
Short and outside off, cut through backward point. The fielder dives to his right and keeps the batsmen to a single. The stand is worth 20 from 34 balls.
Full and outside off, lofted over mid off. The fielder gives it a good chase and slides near the boundary to keep the batsmen to a couple.
Outside off, driven to the left of mid off. The fielder rushes to his left and tumbles to stop the ball. A single taken.
Full and outside off, driven towards the bowler, who gets low to stop but parries it with his left hand towards extra cover.
Tossed up outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Around off, the arm ball, punched towards the leg side. The bowler himself rushes to his right to stop.
Floated outside off, punched straight to cover.
Outside off, driven wide of mid off this time, through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off. 6 fielders are in the ring.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a single.
Double bowling change. Shem Ngoche brings himself on.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Landed outside off, punched towards cover.
Around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
WIDE. This on the other side. Full and miles outside off, let through.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Sachin Bhudia is the first change.

FOUR! Nicely timed, but a terrific effort as well, only to let it loose in the end. Full and around off, Bau drives this straight down the ground, through mid on. Shem Ngoche gives it a good chase from mid off and pulls the ball back in, but unfortunately for him, the ball lands beyond the boundary! 4-0-15-2 for Lucas Oluoch.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full and outside off, let through.
Down the leg side, Vanua looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Landed outside off, watchfully left alone.
Landed outside off, left alone. 22/6 IN THE POWERPLAY. It is not Kenya batting. Who would have imagined that?
Landed outside off, Bau slashes hard but misses.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Outside off, played towards point for a run.
Around off, coming in, Bau tucks it towards square leg and sets off for a single. The fielder charges in and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Had he hit, Vanua was a goner!
Length ball outside off, another play and a miss.
Outside off, another slash and a miss.
Outside off, left alone.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Norman Vanua walks in at number 8, replacing Doriga.

OUT! Caught behind! Another one falls. This is a free fall. Full and outside off, Doriga looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge to the keeper. He stays there but Kenya appeal and up goes the finger!
Around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Full on middle, Doriga drives this straight down the ground. Mid on gives it a chase and the batsmen return for the third.
Landed outside off, guided towards backward point.
Short and outside off, Doriga looks to cut but misses.
Around off, tucked through square leg for a run.
Who is in next? Kiplin Doriga walks in at number 7, replacing Hekure, to face the music.

OUT! Edged and caught again! Gosh. Half the side is back in the hut inside half the Powerplay. Kenya are on a roll. Oluoch lands this around off and forces Hekure to defend. But then, the ball slants away slightly and takes the outside edge. Keeper Irfan Karim does the rest.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Riley Hekure walks in at number 7, replacing Siaka.

OUT! Edged and taken! Fourth wicket down in the span of 7 balls! A length ball outside off, Siaka looks to defend but the ball shapes away, takes the outside edge and flies behind. Colins Obuya dives to his right at first slip and takes a blinder!
Misses the hat-trick! Full and outside off, Bau looks to defend but misses. A sensational opening over from Bundi - WD W 4 1 W W 0!
Sese Bau walks in at number 5, replacing Amini.
OUT! Caught behind! Third wicket in the over! Full and outside off, angling away, Amini looks to drive but gets an outside edge to the keeper!
Charles Amini walks in at number 4, replacing his skipper.
OUT! LBW! Bundi gets another! A length ball, around middle, Vala looks to defend but the ball nips back in, beats the bat, hits the pad and goes behind. The bowler appeals and up goes the finger!
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! FLAMBOYANT! That is a nice way to get off the mark. Half volley wide outside off, Siaka leans and drives it through the covers!
Lega Siaka walks in at number 3, replacing Ura.

OUT! Caught! Now, that is a surprise. The opening stand is broken cheaply. Full and outside off, Ura looks to go over mid off but cannot quite get the elevation. The ball hits the toe end of the bat and goes towards mid off where Shem Ngoche leaps and takes the catch well.
WIDE. Miles outside off, a slash and a miss.
Emmanuel Bundi to share the new ball with Oluoch.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and around off, Ura looks to flick but the ball takes the leading edge and goes to third man. A single taken.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
On a length outside off, Ura pushes inside the line and misses.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a couple.
Around off, defended from the crease.
WIDE. Full and outside off, angling away, left alone.
The players are out in the middle. Tony Ura and Assad Vala open for PNG. Lucas Oluoch will open the bowling, to Ura. Here we go...
PITCH REPORT - Dirk Nannes says that the track looks a bit tricky and the batsmen need to adjust quickly. Does not predict any run scoring or wicket taking today.
TOSS - KENYA HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO CHASE.
It is the final day of the league stages of the WT20 Qualifiers. As many as 5 matches are lined up. Kenya take on PNG here in Dubai while in Abu Dhabi, Nigeria meet Hong Kong.
